title: Jasper in a Jam puppet cartoon
summary: The band recorded Pompton Turnpike and Cherokee for a George Pal cartoon, with animation made afterwards.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: I see Chubby around every once in

a while. The next one is "Jasper in a Jam," a George Pal Puppetoon, 1946. With the action set in a pawnshop where the musical instruments come to life at midnight. Music supplied by Charlie Barnet and His Orchestra, with Peggy Lee. Numbers, "Pompton Turnpike," and, "Cherokee."
Yeah, I remember that. That was a cartoon, you know, and we weren't seen of course in the whole thing. It's all cartoons.
But it was recorded especially for that.
Oh, yes. Yeah. We made the recordings and then he made up the cartoons afterwards, which he already knew what he was going to do, you know, but the --
